description: Retrieve one Prices catalog entry by its id, e.g. pcc-pro, chamber-month, rider-team. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use sku_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the Prices catalog, e.g. pcc-pro, chamber-month, rider-team. Get the id list from sku_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: sku_get
